headings.style: Editorial style, highly readable, tracking-tight for large headings

body.style: Clean, modern, highly legible at small sizes

layout_and_spacing.philosophy: Generous white space throughout, clean and minimal

component_rules.product_cards: Clean, minimal, rounded corners (rounded-2xl), subtle shadow (shadow-sm), image aspect ratio 1:1 or 4:5, off-white/white background.
component_rules.buttons: Action buttons in dark red/maroon (#6E1C1E), rounded-full or rounded-xl, high contrast.
component_rules.badges: Pill shaped (rounded-full), bg-orange-500 text-white or text-orange-600 bg-orange-50. Used for 'CHEF\'S SELECTION'.
component_rules.category_filters: Pill shapes. Inactive: border border-border text-text_secondary. Active state: bg-accent_orange text-white or border-accent_orange text-accent_orange.
component_rules.admin_sidebar: Warm off-white background (#F8F5F0), distinct from pure white content area.

visual_enhancers.borders: Subtle 1px solid borders using #E5E0D8 to separate sections where needed
visual_enhancers.shadows: Very soft ambient shadows for product cards (shadow-[0_4px_20px_rgba(0,0,0,0.03)])

motion_and_interactions.hover_states: Product cards elevate slightly (-translate-y-1) and increase shadow. Buttons darken on hover.

accessibility.contrast: Ensure #212121 on #F8F5F0 and white meets AAA. #6E1C1E and #E55A3D must contrast properly against white.
accessibility.testing: All interactive elements (buttons, links, form inputs) MUST include data-testid attribute formatted as kebab-case, role-based.

image_urls.description: Chef preparing food in a kitchen
Elegant display of gourmet dishes artfully arranged on a marble table.

instructions_to_main_agent: Use ONLY JavaScript (.js) for all files. DO NOT output .tsx or .ts files.
Initialize Tailwind config with the custom brand colors (#F8F5F0, #6E1C1E, #E55A3D, #212121).
Include 'Cormorant Garamond' and 'Manrope' from Google Fonts in the index.html or global css.
Build the skeletons and headers first. Do not add functional features yet; they will be filled in follow-up prompts.
Create placeholders/skeletons for these pages/views: Home Page, Menu/Collection Page, Product Detail Page, Checkout Page, Admin Dashboard, Order Tracking, Loyalty/Subscriptions, Kitchen Operations.
Every interactive element MUST have a 'data-testid' attribute.
Use Shadcn UI (in JS) for standard inputs, dialogs, dropdowns. Customize them to fit the 'Organic & Earthy' theme (generous padding, off-white backgrounds where appropriate).
For the hero section, avoid heavy black overlays over images. Use subtle gradients or position text in negative space.
Admin Dashboard layout MUST use a warm off-white sidebar (#F8F5F0) with a pure white (#FFFFFF) main content area and crisp borders.
